capabilities: Shows notes as boards, calendars, task lists and weekly reviews
Captures thoughts and tasks in one box with a parsed preview
Detects statuses, folders and tags from the existing vault
Distills selected writing into linked notes
Proposes assistant changes as approve cards with undo
disambiguation: Not a charting plugin despite the name; it is a vault dashboard of boards, calendars, tasks, habits and reviews.
extras: Read-only mode on by default; no telemetry, account or server; API key kept in Obsidian secret storage; includes a 279-note demo-vault; needs Obsidian 1.11.4+; Money, Gym and Weight tabs are experimental; uses a few non-public Obsidian internals.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in dashboard, so seeing today's tasks, habits, people and week in one place takes several plugins and manual setup.
